items:
Make a leakage 
 test to check the sample gas lines inside, outside the gas analyzer, and 
 the props inside the boiler as follow:

FINOR to be 
 switched off.

"Sample gas out" 
 connection to be provided with gas tight closure.

Connect a 
 pressure meter to the sample gas line.

Apply a pressure 
 of about 0.1 bar (nitrogen) to the sample gas line, and make the gas tight 
 closure also on the gas inlet so that the entire sample gas rout is closed.

The pressure drop 
 in the closed system should be smaller than 0.5 bar for every 4 minutes of 
 waiting time.

If this is not 
 the case, check the sample gas lines, filter leaking, screwing not correct, 
 hoses porous.

Correct to 
 exactly 21Vol by means of the potentiometer.

Carry out the 
 monthly procedures as MPIS document no. CIS-001-r0.

Connect to sample 
 gas and switch to desired measuring range.

Introduction
This document out lines the testing procedures 
P1, to be performed every three months as indicated by M3 in the title block.
This document 
outlines how to check & schedule service CO%&CO2%&O2% measuring devices.
These gases are the 
exhausts in the boiler, which their percentages must be measured by these 
devices to process them before getting out to the atmospheric air by the 
chimney.
by getting samples 
from 2 levels from the boiler and get into the analyzer in the device, their 
results appear on the indicating meter and recorders.
